name: Texas Invitational
notes: 48 teams in 8 pools of 6 (RR Tables grids, rounds from RR Games) plus the 30-game DE bracket (Mission San Jose beat Frazer in the final). Player stats from the MODAQ export tabs for RR and DE separately, per subject with subject TUH (no energy category); corrects/negs/0s derived exactly from GP, buzzes, PPG, NPG and accuracy. Everett Evergreen MS (L4) forfeited every RR game (0-178 in the grid, stored as forfeits); two players' DE rows were dropped because their games exceed their team's DE games; Redmond/Everett Evergreen MS are middle-school teams entered in this HS field.
